body:
### Vervara Online is a a Civ based RPG set in an ancient fantasy world. Oh, there's magic here too.
![Vervara Online Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/118403789f263f0b00b745d23d17fa919b038a03.gif)

Vervara Online is a tribute to the magepunk genre. Join our amazing community to build towns, engage in geopolitics, master magical spells, embark on rich quests, conquer devious dungeons, and unpack and become part of a player-led lore that runs back nearly a decade.

Our server has no pay-to-win crates or ranks. We opperate entirely by donations and via our server's shop where you can buy cosmetic or non-PvP/PvE perks or items as well as boosters that the _entire_ playerbase gets to benefit from when activated.

This is a Java Edition server.

### 📞 SUPPORT

For Help or Issues:

    Ensure you have the correct IP.
    Make sure you are joining on a supported version.
    Contact support via our Discord: [https://discord.gg/xzRTPYqxDk]

To appeal a ban, please submit an appeal on our Studio Discord [[https://discord.gg/cz5k963Pka](https://discord.gg/cz5k963Pka)].
